title: Hotspot configuration is not reflected unless plasmashell is restarted
line: A hotspot password changed in System Settings is used right away by the Networks widget, without closing System Settings or restarting Plasma.
explanation: The hotspot name and password live in plasma-nm's config file, and the Networks widget re-reads it when another process notifies a change. Since 6.5 the name is synced to disk right away when set, but the password (and the random default password made the first time) was only written to the KConfig in memory, so it reached the disk and the widget only when System Settings quit. Until then, starting a hotspot from the widget used the old password. The change syncs the config right after writing the password, as setHotspotName() already does.

commits.message:
libs/editor: Save the hotspot password to disk right away

The hotspot password, like the random default one, was only written to
disk when the process that set it quit, so the Networks widget kept
using the old one. Sync it right away, as the hotspot name already does.

BUG: 469887

media.caption: Master: the password was changed to ThirdPass99 and OK pressed, but plasma-nm's config file still has SecondPass77
Master: the hotspot started from the Networks widget uses the old SecondPass77
Fixed: after pressing OK with FourthPass11, the config file has FourthPass11 right away
Fixed: the hotspot started from the widget uses FourthPass11

review.text: Clean, minimal fix that adds grp.sync() after writing HotspotPassword in both Configuration::hotspotPassword() (random default generation) and Configuration::setHotspotPassword(), matching setHotspotName() and the other Notify-flagged setters in the same file. This lets plasmashell's existing KConfigWatcher pick up password changes immediately without closing System Settings or restarting Plasma, and the dbusmock before/after verification thoroughly confirms both config persistence and the widget using the new PSK.

reviews.text: Clean, minimal fix that adds grp.sync() after writing HotspotPassword in both Configuration::hotspotPassword() (random default generation) and Configuration::setHotspotPassword(), matching setHotspotName() and the other Notify-flagged setters in the same file. This lets plasmashell's existing KConfigWatcher pick up password changes immediately without closing System Settings or restarting Plasma, and the dbusmock before/after verification thoroughly confirms both config persistence and the widget using the new PSK.

The hotspot name already syncs (6.5), so the remaining half of the report was the password, which was only written to the in-memory KConfig and reached disk (and the widget's KConfigWatcher) when System Settings quit. Adding grp.sync() after the Notify write in setHotspotPassword() and in the generated-default path matches setHotspotName()/setAirplaneModeEnabled() exactly and is the right layer. The dbusmock rig evidence shows the old PSK sent before and the new one after with System Settings still open, and the regressions cover name+password together and the random default. Commit message and explanation match the 2-line diff.
